results.name: Creativity and technology drive Spark's success
results.content:
Spark 2026, powered by Samsung, made its debut at ISE as a meeting point for the creative community.
Spark 2026, powered by Samsung, made its debut at ISE as a meeting point for the creative community. Creators, brands, broadcasters, agencies, in-house teams and production pioneers came together to explore creative practices and how modern content is designed and produced across live, filmed and immersive experiences.
Spark has demonstrated that there is a clear demand for a space where the creative industries and production technology can come together earlier in the production lifecycle, where formats are defined, commissioning decisions are made and production models are established, said Mike Blackman, Managing Director of Integrated Systems Events. Following the success of its launch, Spark will expand in 2027 and move to the Fira Montjuïc venue to meet growing demand and deliver a broader, more ambitious programme. The new venue will enable a wider content programme, larger-scale installations, greater participation and more immersive experience-led formats. Spark 2026 reflected a major industry transformation: the growing convergence of creative production, technology infrastructure and immersive experience design.
Spark showcased emerging creative formats while bringing together creative, production and technology teams from the earliest stages of the process, creating a space where new ideas, workflows and production models can emerge before becoming industry standards.
Samsung, the event's headline sponsor, showcased The Wall for Virtual Production (IVC Series), offering a hands-on experience of next-generation production environments and the evolving language of virtual storytelling. Mark Taylor, Head of Vertical Markets at Samsung Display Solutions Europe, said: What's exciting about Spark is bringing together different manufacturers, speakers and end users to show what's happening in the broadcast industry right now and where it's heading.

snippets.snippet: Spark 2026, powered by Samsung, made its debut at ISE as a meeting point for the creative community. Spark 2026, powered by Samsung, made its debut at ISE as a meeting point for the creative community. Creators, brands, broadcasters, agencies, in-house teams and production pioneers came together to explore creative practices and how modern content is designed and produced across live, filmed and immersive experiences. Spark has demonstrated that there is a clear demand for a space where the creative industries and production technology can come together earlier in the production lifecycle, where formats are defined, commissioning decisions are made and production models are established, said Mike Blackman, Managing Director of Integrated Systems Events. Following the success of its launch, Spark will expand in 2027 and move to the Fira Montjuïc venue to meet growing demand and deliver a broader, more ambitious programme. The new venue will enable a wider content programme, larger-scale installations, greater participation and more immersive experience-led formats. snippets.title: Spark Perceptions Debuts Aurora at MJBizCon 2025 - Marijuana Business Conference & Expo
snippets.snippet: Spark Perceptions debuts Aurora, the automatic precision combustion device redefining performance and design at MJBizCon 2025 — not a vape. Spark Perceptions, a Massachusetts-based technology startup specializing in automatic precision combustion systems, today announced the debut of its flagship device, Aurora, at MJBizCon 2025 in Las Vegas. After months of R&D and engineering refinement, Aurora has completed its engineering validation and is now preparing for mass production. Designed for users who value pure combustion, material efficiency, and effortless handling, Aurora represents the next generation of precision combustion technology — now featuring automatic control that delivers consistent performance with every use. The product embodies Spark Perceptions’ mission to merge scientific precision with practical usability. By launching Aurora at MJBizCon, Spark Perceptions aims to connect with distributors, retail buyers, and technology reviewers who share its vision of elevating combustion technology through design-driven engineering and performance excellence.
